job.title: Senior Java Developer in Tax & Accounting Industry - 100% remote in EU

tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Core Java, REST APIs, SQL Optimization & Cloud Infrastructure
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building and supporting robust enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong command of Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and microservices, with proven expertise in SQL query optimization and performance tuning. Hands-on with cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. Actively accelerates analysis, development, and testing using generative AI tools while delivering clean, reliable solutions in agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Java Developer in Tax & Accounting Industry - 100% remote in EU
cover_en.hook: Pathway Solutions' mission to automate accounting for e-commerce and SaaS companies requires resilient, high-performance backend systems. Bringing over 5 years of professional backend Java engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I build scalable application logic, optimize data pipelines, and actively leverage AI tools to drive high-quality software delivery.

bullets.label: Robust Java Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented enterprise backend functionality using Core Java, Spring, and established design patterns, managing complex catalog, pricing, and transactional data structures.

bullets.label: API Integrations & Migrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed high-volume RESTful web services for distributed consumers, engineered API migrations, and resolved complex integration bottlenecks with external platforms.

bullets.label: Performance & SQL Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, while managing production troubleshooting to maintain system stability under load.

bullets.label: DevOps & AI-Assisted Delivery
bullets.text: Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD deployment cycles, combining rigorous code reviews with generative AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and documentation.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my Java and backend background can support Pathway's growing platform.

tailoring.why_company: Pathway Solutions' mission to eliminate manual bookkeeping for e-commerce and SaaS entrepreneurs tackles a crucial operational challenge where reliability and transaction consistency are paramount. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of Java backend experience and SQL performance tuning to scale your core billing and invoicing engines, working within a high-trust, remote-first team driving continuous AI adoption.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated to bring 5+ years of backend Java expertise, database performance tuning, and AI-assisted delivery to Pathway Solutions to build scalable, fault-tolerant billing systems that eliminate manual bookkeeping for e-commerce businesses.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I saw Pathway's Senior Java Developer opening. With 5+ years in Java backend engineering, high-volume REST APIs, SQL optimization, and AI tooling at Rockwell and Shell, I would love to contribute to your core billing systems. Resume attached!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Java Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Java Developer position at pathway solutions gmbh. With over 5 years of professional backend development experience in Java, RESTful web services, SQL query optimization, and cloud environments, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to your billing and invoice generation systems.

I look forward to discussing how my experience can support Pathway's growth.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
